description: This file implements core filesystem classes and functions, including File, Directory, and Partition, with platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems. It handles file info loading, path normalization, directory creation, existence checks, and partition info retrieval.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with methods for loading info, normalizing paths, and managing file attributes.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory with methods for creation, existence check, and permissions.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Represents a disk partition with methods to load partition info and read partition name.

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes file paths, removing redundant slashes, dots, and handling relative paths.

methods.name: LoadFileInfo
methods.description: Loads file attributes, size, and timestamps from the filesystem.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified location.

methods.name: CreatePath
methods.description: Recursively creates directories along a path.

methods.name: LoadPartitionInfo
methods.description: Loads partition size, free space, and device name.
